title: Falco, Carmine; wife Francesca [nee Zampiello]; and child Giuseppina [known as Josephine]
significance: THE FAMILY FILE. Carmine Falco b. 1930, Francesca Zampiello b. 1928, Giuseppina b. 1955 — called Josephine in Australia. The c. 1957 arrival inferred from this date range is WRONG: the passenger list of the ss Sydney (item 12100311) has the family arriving 26 March 1964.

title: Falco, Raffaele [Italian, born 1925]; wife Caterina [nee Zampiello]; and children Filomena and Antonio
significance: Raffaele b. 1925 = the son of Carminantonio & Filomena born at Benevento in 1925. His wife Caterina nee ZAMPIELLO matches the Caterina Falco b. 7 Jul 1925 buried at Nudgee V-0947. Daughter Filomena is named for her grandmother.

title: Zampiello, Angelo
significance: Angelo Zampiello b. 31 Aug 1895, d. 1972 — Francesca's father. He has his own Brisbane file.

title: Servodio, Angelo Michele; wife Raffaela [nee Zampiello]; and children Maria, Angelo
significance: Raffaela Zampiello — a third sister in Brisbane.

title: MICELI Umberto b. 22 Dec 1934; Filomena (nee Zampiello) b. 24 Aug 1932 — per ship ROMA, 1960, Australian/Italian Assisted Migration Agreement
significance: Filomena Zampiello b. 24 Aug 1932 — a fourth sister, with her exact birth date and her ship.

title: Prisoner of War/Internee: Zampiello, Giovanni; b. 1 Dec 1911; Italian
significance: An Italian POW or internee in Australia. Relationship untested — but Zampiello is a one-village name.

title: Prisoner of War/Internee; Zampiello, Giovanni; b. 1911; Italian
significance: The same man, second Melbourne file.

title: Incoming passenger list, "Sydney", 26 March 1964 — FALCO Carmine, Francesca, Giuseppina and Antonio; port of arrival Brisbane; embarked Naples
significance: THE ARRIVAL. The whole family on one voyage. Antonio is a fourth Falco not previously placed — almost certainly Giuseppina's brother, the "Anthony Falco" of the family tree.
